name: DAMA/LIBRA annual modulation
notes: DAMA/NaI 1998 -> DAMA/LIBRA 2008 (~8 sigma), 12.9 sigma by 2018; same-target NaI(Tl) tests COSINE-100 (2018 Nature: no DM-compatible excess; later modulation null) and ANAIS-112 (2019-2025, excludes DAMA modulation at >3-4 sigma); cause still unidentified

name: CoGeNT low-energy excess and 2.8 sigma modulation
notes: modulation claim 2011; surface-event (slow-pulse) leakage; CoGeNT 2014 reanalysis and Davis et al. 2014; excluded by CDMSlite/SuperCDMS/LUX

name: CDMS-II silicon three events
notes: profile-likelihood p = 0.19 % (~3 sigma) for WIMP+bkg vs bkg; 5.4 % that known backgrounds give >= 3 events; LUX Oct 2013 and SuperCDMS 2014 excluded the region

name: CRESST-II excess (Run 32)
notes: two maxima at 4.2 and 4.7 sigma; traced to alpha/Pb-recoil backgrounds from the bronze clamps; 2014 upgraded modules showed no excess

name: XENON1T electronic-recoil excess
n_events: 285 obs vs 232 exp (53 excess) at 1-7 keV
notes: 3.3 sigma solar axion, 3.2 sigma tritium alternative; XENONnT 2022 (5x lower ER background) saw no excess; cause never identified (tritium or fluctuation)

name: XENON100 annual modulation (ER band)
notes: 2.8 sigma periodicity; DAMA-like interpretation excluded at 4.8 sigma in the same paper; 4-year dataset (2017) reduced it to ~1.9 sigma

name: EDELWEISS-II five events
notes: recalled only vaguely; sub-2 sigma; superseded by EDELWEISS-III and the CDMS/EDELWEISS combination; EXCLUDED from primary counts

name: CDMS-II germanium two events
notes: p = 0.23 for >= 2 background events; below the 2.5 sigma window; region excluded by XENON100 2010-2011

name: Cryogenic low-energy excess (CRESST-III, EDELWEISS, SuperCDMS-CPD, NUCLEUS)
n_events: thousands of events rising below ~200 eV
notes: EXCESS workshop 2021; leading hypothesis stress/relaxation artefact, not DM; no significance quoted; censored

name: XENON1T 124Xe double electron capture
notes: predicted SM process (half-life 1.8e22 yr); confirmed by XENONnT 2022 and LZ 2024; above the 4 sigma window

name: 8B solar-neutrino CEvNS (PandaX-4T 2.64 sigma, XENONnT 2.73 sigma)
notes: predicted SM rate; two experiments each ~2.7 sigma; not yet 5 sigma as of Sept 2026 to our knowledge; censored

name: ATLAS/CMS 750 GeV diphoton
notes: ATLAS 3.9 local / 2.1 global, CMS 2.6 local; gone with 2016 data (ICHEP Aug 2016)

name: Fermi-LAT 130 GeV gamma-ray line
notes: Weniger 2012 on public data; Fermi-LAT 2013: weaker, similar feature in Earth-limb control; absent in Pass 8 (2015); partly instrumental

name: 3.5 keV X-ray line (stacked clusters, Andromeda, Perseus)
n_events: few-% of continuum in stacked spectra
notes: Bulbul et al. 4-5 sigma, Boyarsky et al. 4.4 sigma; Hitomi 2017 Perseus null, Dessert et al. 2020 blank-sky null, disputed; censored; above window

name: BICEP2 B-mode polarisation (r = 0.20)
notes: Galactic dust; Planck 353 GHz Sept 2014, joint BICEP2/Keck/Planck Jan 2015; above window

name: OPERA superluminal neutrinos
notes: loose optical-fibre connector and clock oscillator; ICARUS independent null 2012; above window

name: LEP Higgs hint at 115 GeV
notes: LEP combination Nov 2000 ~2.9 sigma; final 2003 combination 1.7 sigma; Higgs found at 125 GeV in 2012

name: ATLAS/CMS Higgs hints Dec 2011
notes: ATLAS 3.6 local / 2.3 global at 126 GeV, CMS 2.6 local; discovery July 2012

name: CDF top-quark evidence 1994
notes: discovery by CDF and D0 in Feb 1995

name: IceCube two PeV cascades (2012 data)
notes: 2.8 sigma above atmospheric expectation; 28 events / 4.1 sigma later in 2013; 5.7 sigma 2014

name: IceCube Glashow-resonance candidate (6 PeV)
notes: single event detected 2016, published 2021; consistent with SM expectation; a single event cannot be confirmed statistically; censored; below window

name: KM3NeT KM3-230213A (~220 PeV muon)
notes: tension of ~2.5-3 sigma with IceCube/Auger non-observation of a corresponding flux; censored

name: ANITA anomalous upgoing air-shower events
notes: steady-source interpretations constrained by IceCube 2020; reflection/artefact hypotheses; PUEO to test; censored

name: MiniBooNE low-energy excess
notes: ~3 sigma by 2009, 4.8 sigma 2018 (6 sigma with LSND); MicroBooNE 2021 saw no electron-like excess; photon-like channel open; censored

name: LSND anti-nu_e appearance
notes: KARMEN excluded part of the region; sterile-neutrino fits in tension; censored

name: EDGES 21-cm absorption trough
notes: SARAS 3 (2022) rejects the EDGES profile at 95.3 %; leading hypothesis ground-plane/systematics

name: LHCb R_K lepton-universality anomaly
n_events: hundreds of B+ -> K+ l+ l-
notes: 3.1 sigma March 2021 (anomalies since 2014); Dec 2022 reanalysis: misidentified hadronic backgrounds, R_K SM-compatible

name: Muon g-2 (BNL final -> FNAL)
notes: 2.7 sigma (2004), 3.3-3.7 with later theory, 4.2 (2021), 5.0 (2023) vs 2020 white paper; lattice HVP (BMW 2020) and the 2025 theory update remove most of the discrepancy (recalled: likely)

name: CDF W-boson mass (7 sigma)
notes: ATLAS 2023 and CMS 2024 SM-consistent; cause unidentified; above window

name: ATOMKI X17 (8Be, 4He angular correlations)
notes: MEG II 2024 finds no signal (recalled: likely); several other null/partial tests; censored; above window

name: Reactor antineutrino anomaly
notes: Daya Bay fuel-evolution 2017, Kurchatov 235U/238U ratio 2021: 235U flux prediction was off; largely a flux-model error

name: Gallium anomaly (GALLEX/SAGE -> BEST)
notes: ~2.5-3 sigma 2010; BEST 2022 ~4 sigma; censored

name: Heidelberg-Moscow 0nubb claim
notes: 2.2-3.1 sigma (2001), 4.2 (2004), 6 (2006); GERDA 2013 excluded the claim; KamLAND-Zen/EXO-200 likewise

name: DAMPE 1.4 TeV electron-positron peak
notes: significance and status recalled only vaguely; EXCLUDED from primary counts

name: CDF W+jj 145 GeV bump
notes: 4.1 sigma with more data; D0 null; CDF 2012 traced to jet-energy-scale / background modelling

name: Tevatron top forward-backward asymmetry
notes: CDF high-mass A_FB; NNLO QCD (2015) and D0/more data closed the gap

name: HERA high-Q2 events (H1/ZEUS 1997)
notes: leptoquark interpretation; excess did not grow with 1998-2000 data

name: ALEPH four-jet events at 105 GeV
notes: not seen by DELPHI/L3/OPAL; faded in 1997

name: Pentaquark Theta+(1540)
notes: several 4-5 sigma claims 2003-2004; CLAS high-statistics 2006 null; above window

name: CMS 95 GeV diphoton excess
notes: 2.8 sigma (2018), 2.9 sigma local (2023); ATLAS 1.7 sigma; censored

notes: 2019 conference result; 2020-2021 reanalysis: charged-kaon and halo-neutron backgrounds; upper limit published
